about_the_game:
The maniacal Chronolith, Imperial Ruler of the Trans-Dimensional Realm, is rewriting the past, and only you can stop his evil minions of doom from unraveling time itself!

Time Enforcers is an action-packed role-playing adventure blended with an interactive digital comic designed to make learning history exciting and fun.

As a Galactic Space-Time Continuum (GSTC) recruit, you’ll work under the guidance of HG Wells, Executive Director of the GSTC, and Professor CT Huygens, Director of Temporal Dynamics, to find a way to stop this madness.

Alongside the enigmatic Time Enforcer Agent, Samurai Warrior Kaizen, you must:

• Travel through time to a pivotal moment in Japan’s history.

• Engage in turn-based battles against Chronolith’s minions who seek to alter the past.

• Solve historical puzzles posed by Chronolith’s lieutenant, the Inquisitor, to continue your mission.

• Experience fully animated cutscenes with voice-overs and narrations, timed word balloons, and thought bubbles to engage players of all ages.

• Meet a mix of real and fictional characters inspired by history, each with a role in the unfolding adventure.

Designed for kids and the young at heart, Time Enforcers transforms real-world history into a thrilling adventure.

Can you stop Chronolith before the past—and the future—are lost forever?
